Let X, Y in [0, 1]. P(|X - Y| <= 1/2) = 1 - P(|X - Y| > 1/2).
The region |X - Y| > 1/2 consists of two triangles each of area (1/2)(1/2)(1/2) = 1/8.
Total unfavorable area = 1/8 + 1/8 = 1/4.
Probability = 1 - 1/4 = 3/4.
